verdict.rationale: For a GPU, the relevant public API is its compute software stack. AMD documents the open-source ROCm stack for the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201), with official install and usage pages for PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, ONNX, vLLM, SGLang and Docker on Linux and Windows. An llms.txt is also served for agent consumption. The missing OpenAPI spec is expected, since a GPU is not a REST service. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party HIP/ROCm API reference cited in the evidence, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the card programmatically.
